description: Image Description: The image depicts a group of elephants gathered near and in a shallow, muddy river within a dense forested area. The scene is set during what appears to be either dawn or dusk, as the lighting is dim and subdued, casting soft shadows across the landscape. Several elephants are partially submerged in the water, with some standing and others lying down, suggesting they are bathing or cooling off. Their dark gray skin contrasts with the murky brown water, which reflects subtle ripples from their movements.
